integrity: Finite rational matrix identities are reproducible with a Python 3 standard-library checker. Asymptotic analyticity follows from nonsingular normalized finite-state systems; no finite simulation is used as proof. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Local fifth-order asymptotic for exactly three particles on a unit-rate three-site complete graph with uniform copying; does not determine global sign for all positive killing vectors. The opposite cubic response for \(N\ge4\) is established in the cited motivating work, not reproved here. Mathematical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Quintic onset and orientation reversal of three-particle ancestral circulation
